units.source_text: 一種「遊戲」心態仍潛伏在身體的某處。

en.t: Some sort of playful attitude was still lurking somewhere in my body.

units.source_text: 那天上午，我們倆一起徘徊遊蕩在淺草的六區，進了一家咖啡館，各自喝了一杯牛奶。

en.t: That morning, the two of us wandered around the Rokku district of Asakusa, went into a cafe, and each drank a glass of milk.

units.source_text: 我站起身，從袖口裡掏出錢包，開啟一看，只有三塊銅幣，

en.t: I stood up, pulled my purse from my sleeve, opened it, and found only three copper coins,

units.source_text: 一種比羞恥更慘烈的感覺襲遍全身，突然間，我的腦海裡浮現出自己在仙遊館的那個房間，

en.t: a feeling more terrible than shame swept through my whole body, and suddenly there appeared in my mind that room of mine at Senyukan,

units.source_text: 那個只剩下學生制服和坐墊，再也沒有任何物品可以拿去典當的荒涼房間。

en.t: that desolate room where only my student uniform and cushion remained, with nothing at all left that could be pawned.

units.source_text: 除此之外，我所有的家當就只有穿在身上的碎花和服與披風了。

en.t: Apart from that, all I owned were the patterned kimono I was wearing and my cape.

units.source_text: 這就是我生活的現實，我非常清楚，自己真的活不下去了。

en.t: This was the reality of my life, and I understood very clearly that I truly could not go on living.
